 Duties will include reviewing the schedule of all events scheduled for the coming week and the next day. You will provide health checks for the spaces at the start of the day and before the event to ensure the functionality of the space is up and running. You will oversee all the AV devices across the location and keep an active track of their health and whereabouts to ensure they are being checked and replaced as needed based on utilization. You will keep the local leadership and reporting lead updated on the day\-to\-day activities and challenges surfaced during the events, sessions, or meetings.

* Plan, coordinate, and execute live production events, including the setup, operation, and breakdown of live streaming and AV equipment.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all technical and logistical aspects of events are addressed.
* Monitor the health of AV equipment and video endpoints to ensure proper maintenance and optimal performance.
* Develop and implement best practices for AV operations and live event production, continuously seeking ways to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Interact with all the team members across USI offices to stay updated on ongoing processes and new changes, ensuring consistent standards are maintained across the board to deliver a uniform client experience.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Setting up equipment in collaboration space and at events – from initial setup to wrap\-up.
* Diagnosing and troubleshooting issues related to AV equipment during testing and events.
* Intermediate\-level experience with event technology platforms and AV equipment. Candidates should have experience producing events using virtual\-event and web\-conferencing platforms.
* Working knowledge of basic office live\-streaming setups, including cameras, microphones, audio mixers, presentation sources, encoders, and streaming platforms, with the ability to perform setup, testing, operation, and L1 troubleshooting.
* Experience troubleshooting L1/L2 incidents related to virtual\-event platforms such as Zoom and Microsoft Teams, including the ability to recommend technical workarounds as needed.
* Working knowledge of videoconferencing products such as Poly Studio X30 , X50, and X70 systems and Cisco video endpoints, including the ability to troubleshoot L1/L2 issues through platform interfaces such as the Zoom Dashboard and Cisco Control Hub.
* Experience working on ticketing tools such as ServiceNow is essential.
* Certification or additional degrees in AV, Sound engineering or related field is a plus.


**Required Professional Skills**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for client interactions and team coordination.
* This position will be privy to confidential, classified, and unpublished information; therefore, it is critical that discretion and confidentially are always exercised and at the forefront of all communications written and verbal.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, including ability to propose solutions and explanations in writing and collaborate with a wide range of teams to oversee events.
* Attention to detail to ensure high\-quality event delivery and client satisfaction.
* Ability to follow instructions, remain professional under pressure and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Associate TSE II
description:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Cool things you’ll do
   

  

 You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges \- resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
   

  

 As an ideal candidate, you will have
   

  

 We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self taught, curious, and multi\-faceted. Our ideal ATSE II candidate should have:
   

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience
* Strong understanding and grasp of the following areas
* Systems administration
* Troubleshooting Systems
* Scalable and Highly available distributed systems
* Network Administration
* Application Architecture
* Data architecture and design
* Understanding of database architecture and administration
* Experience in performance tuning and benchmarking
* Previous experience in technical support
* A B.Tech / B.S. or equivalent work experience


 Nice to have
   

  

* Comfortable with modern AI concepts and proficient in using AI\-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting and enhance day\-to\-day technical support workflows.
* Knowledge on one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl
* It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Genuine desire to help people
* Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real\-time
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
* Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. title: Network Services Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Network Services Specialist** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Publicis Re:Sources is at the core of Publicis Groupe, the world's largest communications company. We are the only full\-service, end\-to\-end shared service organization in the industry, enabling Groupe agencies to do what they do best: innovate and transform for their clients. Formed in 1998 as a small team to service a few Publicis Groupe firms, Publicis Re:Sources has grown to 6,000\+ employees in over 55 countries. We provide technology solutions and business services, including finance, accounting, legal, benefits, procurement, tax, real estate, treasury and risk management, information security, and global mobility — supporting 110,000\+ employees across the Publicis Groupe network. Our people are at the centre of everything we do, bringing curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence to their work every day. Learn more about Publicis Re:Sources and the Publicis Groupe agencies we support at publicisresources.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Role Summary: We are seeking an experienced and proactive Network Services Specialist to lead and manage enterprise network infrastructure, operations, and support services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, security, performance, and scalability of LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud networking environments. This role involves team leadership, vendor coordination, project execution, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Network Operations \& Management
* Manage day\-to\-day operations of enterprise network infrastructure.
* Ensure high availability and optimal performance of LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD\-WAN, VPN, internet, and data center networks.
* Monitor network health, capacity, utilization, and performance using monitoring tools.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of critical network incidents and outages.
* Maintain network uptime in line with business SLAs.
* Infrastructure \& Technologies
* Manage Cisco routing and switching environments including Catalyst, Nexus, and wireless solutions.
* Support technologies such as:
* BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS
* VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP
* SD\-WAN and VPN technologies
* Firewalls and network security solutions
* Cisco ACI, NAC, ISE, and wireless controllers
* Cloud networking (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Oversee network upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management.
* Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor network engineers and support teams.
* Allocate tasks and manage operational priorities.
* Conduct performance reviews and technical coaching.
* Ensure adherence to operational processes and documentation standards.
* Incident \& Change Management
* Manage Major Incident handling and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Participate in CAB meetings and approve network changes.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL processes including incident, problem, and change management.
* Coordinate with TAC, ISPs, and third\-party vendors during escalations.
* Security \& Compliance
* Ensure network security best practices are implemented.
* Work closely with security teams on audits, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
* Manage firewall policies, NAC solutions, segmentation, and access control.
* Project Management
* Plan and execute network\-related projects.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams for infrastructure deployments.
* Prepare project documentation, implementation plans, and risk assessments.
* Manage vendor relationships and procurement activities.
* Documentation \& Reporting
* Maintain network diagrams, SOPs, inventory, and technical documentation.
* Prepare operational reports, service metrics, and management dashboards.
* Track KPIs and service improvement initiatives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Qualifications Required Education
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 12 to 15 years of experience in network engineering and operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years as technical specialist or consultant role.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




  




* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco routers, switches, and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with:
* Cisco Catalyst 9K, Nexus, ISR/ASR platforms
* Cisco ACI and Cisco ISE
* Routing protocols: BGP and OSPF
* Network monitoring and troubleshooting tools
* Cisco Wireless – Skills \& Experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco enterprise wireless solutions and WLAN architecture.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst 9800 Series Wireless LAN Controllers, including high availability, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and software upgrades.
* Experience supporting Cisco Catalyst/Aironet Access Points and enterprise WLAN deployments.
* Strong understanding of 802\.11 wireless technologies, RF fundamentals, channels, channel width, transmit power, coverage, capacity, and interference management.
* Experience with 2\.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz wireless networks, including Wi\-Fi 6/6E and newer wireless technologies.
* Troubleshoot wireless client connectivity

title: Workday Specialist, GCC
description:
*Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Workday Specialist* 
*to join our office in Gurugram, India.*
**Team**
 The Gurugram office of CIP Fund Solutions supports fund management, investment activities and integrated business services across the CIP platform. This office combines local presence with close integration across a global organization. It supports specialist delivery across functions and contributes to scalable, high\-quality execution.
   

  

 As part of our Global People team, you will work closely with HR, and business stakeholders to maximise the value of our Workday platform and report directly to Senior Manager, People Technology and Operations. You will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of HR system, driving continuous improvements, and supporting the delivery of scalable HR solutions that meet the needs of a dynamic and growing business.
   

  

**Role**
 You will help optimize our Workday platform and contribute to the development of our HR Operating Model. This includes system configuration, user support, reporting, data management, process improvements, system enhancements, releases, and the implementation of new modules and integrations as required.
   

  

 You will work in a work\-from\-office environment, collaborating closely with colleagues and working daily with the Workday HRIS.
   

  

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**
**Workday Administration \& Support**
* Configure and maintain Workday Core HCM functionality.
* Manage and resolve support tickets related to Workday modules (Core HCM, Compensation, Recruitment, Reporting, etc).
* Troubleshoot system issues and work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive timely resolution.
* Assist with system configuration updates, data uploads, and testing for ongoing enhancements (WD releases).


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Act as focal point for Reporting needs and development.
* Design and maintain custom reports and dashboards.
* Develop calculated fields and Report\-as\-a\-Service (RaaS) solutions.
* Provide workforce metrics, headcount reports, attrition analysis, and compliance reporting.


**Data Integrity, Documentation \& Training**
* Ensure data integrity by performing audits and routine system checks.
* Document processes, maintain user guides, and support training efforts for end users.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Collaborate with HR, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure the system supports business needs.
* Act as a trusted advisor on Workday\-related processes and capabilities.


**You**
 We are looking for a motivated individual holding a relevant degree in Information Technology, Digital Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, with 5\+ years of experience in Workday HRIS administration, implementation, or application management roles. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required.
   

  

 You have hands\-on experience working with Workday HCM, including configuration, business process design, reporting, security administration, EIBs, and data management. You have a strong track record of optimising and enhancing HR systems within international organisations and driving process improvements and automation across multiple Workday modules, supported by a solid understanding of HR processes and workflows.
   

  

 Integration experience within the Workday ecosystem is considered a nice\-to\-have.
   

  

**We look for the following in a candidate:**
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage issues, handle conflicts, and drive escalations to resolution effectively.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships and work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken, with the confidence to engage with stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised and detail\-oriented, with a structured approach to work and the ability to prioritise effectively during busy periods.
* Strong cross\-cultural awareness and a service\-oriented mindset, with experience supporting stakeholders across different countries, time zones, and working cultures.


**The process**
 Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
   

  

 As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
   

  

 Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
 CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
   

  

 A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.
   

  

**CIP Fund Solutions**
 CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy\-period \- supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large\-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M\&A.
   

  

 For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

title: Service Operations Specialist
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**PURPOSE**
 The L2 Voice Operations position is a key role within the Command Center, supporting SITA’s global IP Telephony, Unified Communications, and Collaboration products and services. The Command Center provides end\-to\-end support to a worldwide customer base, requiring high technical expertise to remain fully self\-sufficient.
   

  

 The primary focus is ensuring timely resolution of Level 2 incidents and implementing approved changes where applicable. As the specialist in IP Telephony, Unified Communications, and Collaboration, the role is also accountable for driving resolution of major incidents in crisis situations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide customers with professional, timely, and effective technical expertise for IP Telephony, Unified Communications, and Collaboration services.
* Support or provision customer voice network changes on time, focusing on process improvement and first\-time\-right execution.
* Own voice service incidents across complex topologies and apply a methodical problem\-solving approach with escalation to suppliers as needed.
* Implement change requests for Cisco, AudioCodes SBCs, and Genesys Cloud solutions.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date customer voice topology database.
* Actively contribute to process improvement and mapping within the ITIL framework.
* Drive customer satisfaction by delivering high\-quality support.
* Understand complex integrations: Contact Center, IP\-PBX, SIP, Voice Gateway, and network interconnection.
* Support integrations with Cloud Service Providers (Genesys, Microsoft, etc.).


**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Communications, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of operational experience in a 24x7 environment.
* Certifications: CCNA/CCNP Collaboration, Networking (preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Cisco ISR G2/G3 VG/CUBE.
* Good knowledge of SIP, H.323, MGCP, SCCP, ISDN.
* Experience with VMware ESXi and Cisco UCS\-C servers.
* Good knowledge of Genesys Cloud, Microsoft voice services, and Cisco Unified Communications.
* Knowledge of Cisco switches, routers, and firewalls.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Linux SSH, SFTP, TFTP, FTP, DHCP, NTP.
* ITIL framework knowledge and operational best practices.
* Strong customer\-focused attitude, problem\-solving, and root cause identification skills.
* Excellent communication skills at all levels, both internally and externally.
* Team\-oriented with the ability to influence and drive common goals.


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Expertise in IP Telephony, Unified Communications, and Collaboration platforms.
* VoIP protocols: SIP, H.323, MGCP, SCCP, ISDN; advanced troubleshooting in mixed TDM/IP environments.
* Customer service mindset: proactive ownership of incidents until resolution.
* Ability to work in global 24x7 operations with rotating shifts.
* Analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex voice, network, and UC issues with root cause analysis capability.
* Collaboration skills with peers, management, customers, and third\-party providers.
* Experience with ITIL processes.
* Capable of mentoring and onboarding new team members.
* Strong organizational skills to manage incidents and changes effectively.


**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
* IP Telephony, Unified Communications, and Collaboration concepts.
* Voice \& UC Infrastructure platforms (CUCM, CUBE, Genesys Cloud, AudioCodes SBCs).
* Incident \& Change Management processes (ITIL\-based).
* Strong technical communication skills for coordination with customers and suppliers.


**CORE COMPETENCIES**
* Adhering to Principles \& Values
* Clear and Effective Communication
* Customer Focus \& Relationship Management
* Problem Solving \& Innovation
* Impact \& Influence in Major Incident Scenarios
* Leading Execution in Crisis Mode
* Results Orientation
* Teamwork and Collaboration


**Education \& Qualifications**
* Industry certifications: CCNA/CCNP Collaboration, CCNP Enterprise (preferred).
* ITIL Foundation Certificate.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent diploma/certificate in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, or Telecommunications.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring \& resolution in large\-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi\-vendor infrastructures.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS\-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.

description:

 Job Summary

 Maintenance \& Service Management

 Documentation \& Reporting

 Required Qualifications
 


* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related field.

 Technical Skills
 


* Industrial Automation Systems

 Core Competencies
 


* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills

* Adaptability and willingness to travel extensively



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Deployment completion within planned timelines
* System uptime of ≥ 98%
* Reduction in post\-deployment issues and escalations
* Customer satisfaction score of ≥ 4\.5/5

description:
**Associate Senior Service Delivery Officer (Regional Partner \& Technology Advocate)**
 Job \#: req38471
   

  

 Organization: World Bank
   

  

 Sector: Information Technology
   

  

 Grade: GG
   

  

 Term Duration: Open\-Ended Staff (OPEN\-OP)

 Required Language(s): English
   

  

**Preferred Language(s)**
 Closing Date: 10/12/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
   

  

**Description**
 At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd
   

  

**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
 The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150\+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload\=9\&v\=VTFGffa1Y7w
   

  

**Department Context**
 The World Bank Group (WBG) is committed to supporting country clients in achieving sustainable development outcomes, including improved health systems, economic growth, education access, climate resilience, and social equity. In this context, digital platforms and data play an increasingly critical role in how development projects are designed, implemented, and adapted.
   

  

 The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables digital enablement of the Bank's business processes through a modern, flexible, and user\-friendly digital platform that integrates and optimizes critical functions for thousands of front\-line staff. It also drives the delivery of AI\-powered business solutions to support business priorities and accelerate data\-driven decision\-making across the institution.
   

  

 To strengthen the feedback loop between the realities on the ground and the digital tools that support operations, ITSOP is seeking a Regional Partner embedded within regional operations. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to task teams, regional leadership, and product teams in identifying opportunities to optimize operations through fit\-for\-purpose technology solutions and smarter business processes.
   

  

 As ITSOP advances the reimagining and modernization of the Operations Workspace and related digital platforms, the Regional Partner will play a critical role in supporting three parallel dimensions of change: sustaining day\-to\-day business operations, helping modernization, promoting and contributing to organizational readiness and adoption, and contributing to strategic transformation initiatives. The role will ensure that regional operational realities, stakeholder needs, and field perspectives are incorporated into the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of future digital capabilities and operating models.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role combines strategic advisory, user and business engagement, and technology enablement, with the goal of helping WBG operations teams implement policies, deliver programs, and scale impact through digital tools and data\-informed practices. This role is part of our commitment to ensuring that digital platforms not only support, but enable operational effectiveness, innovation, and implementation on the ground.
   

  

**The Regional Partner Will Be a**
* Strategic thought partner to regional/country task teams in identifying operational challenges and technology needs.
* Liaison between field realities and the internal product development lifecycle.
* Facilitator of informed decision\-making around digital adoption, technology innovation, and process efficiency.


 This is a solution\-oriented role, requiring strong systems thinking, client orientation, and understanding of both the development context and the possibilities (and limitations) of technology. This role promotes a culture of innovation and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Regional Partner will play a dual\-facing role, working closely with both task teams and regional leadership, and with internal technology and product teams, carrying out the following responsibilities:
   

  

* User and Business Engagement and Operational Insight
* Serve as a trusted advisor to task teams (TTLs), project staff, and regional management on operational technology needs.
* Understand and analyze end\-to\-end business processes across sectors (e.g., health, education) to understand the full context of operations—program goals, delivery challenges, and field constraints, and identify opportunities for efficiency and digital enablement.
* Provide strategic guidance on how existing or new digital solutions can support evolving operational requirements and policy implementation.
* Surface unspoken or emerging needs based on\-the\-ground observation, interviews, and data insights.
* Recommend improvements to business processes through the application of digital tools, automation, or data\-informed workflows.
* Identify patterns or recurring challenges across countries or sectors that can be addressed systemically.
* Advise regional teams on implementation strategies for operational policy changes that require digital adaptation.
* Support regional stakeholders through business and technology transformation initiatives by assessing impacts, gathering requirements, validating future\-state processes, and ensuring operational realities are reflected in transformation planning and execution.
* Technology Advisory and Bridging
* Partner with product managers and solution architects on the design and evolution of digital platforms by providing business context, use cases, and field insights.
* Act as a bridge between regional business teams and central product development teams, translating complex operational problems into clearly scoped technical solutions.
* Evaluate existing technological solutions that may address observed needs, recommend fit\-for\-purpose adaptations where needed.
* Support prioritization by providing business impact framing, user insights, and field validation to product managers.
* Monitor and facilitate technology adoption, performance, and user satisfaction within the region and provide feedback for continuous improvement.
* Change Management and Implementation Support
* Provide thought partnership with regional teams in designing business processes that are both policy\-compliant and technology\-enabled.
* Ensure alignment between institutional operational policies and technical implementation across platforms.
* Work with business and technical teams to promote the adoption of new tools and enhancements, drawing on field insights to shape communication, training, and support strategies.
* Support organizational learning by sharing case studies, user stories, and actionable feedback from the field.
* Support the implementation of new digital tools, features, or policies by facilitating change management, user communication, and engagement activities.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reporting:


 Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for innovative initiatives. Track progress, measure impact, and report outcomes to management.
   

  

* Knowledge Management:


 Document lessons learned, best practices, and case studies. Contribute to the Bank’s innovation knowledge base and support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Selection Criteria
   

  

* Master’s degree in computer science/STEM with 8 years relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in computer science with a minimum of 10 years relevant experience.
* Relevant areas of experience include (i) development or multilateral operations, (ii) technology advisory, consulting, or technology innovation, (iii) digital transformation and large\-scale business modernization initiatives, including organization change and technology adoption, and (iv) field program implementation
* Demonstrated expertise in emerging technologies, systems thinking, acting as a liaison, change management, evangelization, and innovation methodologies (e.g., AI, design thinking, agile)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Experience working in large, complex organizations or international development settings
* Familiarity with the World Bank’s operations, governance, and organizational structure preferred
* Understanding of the World Bank’s operational frameworks and platforms (e.g., the Operations Platform) preferred
* Experience in field\-embedded roles that require active collaboration with country teams and task teams in\-region. Multilingual capabilities are a plus.
* Certified in SAFe Agilist, Digital Transformation, Organization Change Management, Design Thinking, or other industries preferred


**Core Competencies**
* Operational Excellence: Deep understanding of business processes related to development operations (e.g., project design, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation). Ability to interpret and apply operational policy in a digital transformation context.
* Client Orientation: Experience working with multidisciplinary teams, including technical teams, field\-based staff, and senior leadership. Deep empathy for field teams and country contexts; able to represent their needs with credibility and nuance.
* Analytical and Systems Thinking: Ability to assess complex operational environments and propose realistic, innovative, and scalable digital solutions.
* Digital Acumen: Familiarity with enterprise platforms, digital transformation, AI, and data\-driven decision\-making; not necessarily a technical expert, but a confident translator of technology for non\-technical audiences.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present technical content to non\-technical audiences. Capacity to write clear documentation, briefs, and presentations tailored to varied stakeholder groups.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, and diverse cultural contexts across geographical boundaries.
* Problem Solving and Innovation: Capacity to ideate and test new approaches; consultative mindset with a strong focus on user value and long\-term impact. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


 As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
   

  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI\-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision\-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict\-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.


**WBG Culture Attributes**
* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


 World Bank Group Core Competencies
   

  

 WBG Five Managerial Competencies Include only for managerial positions
   

  

 The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.

In this capacity, you will provide leadership, guidance, and coordination support to the local IT support team, while not being their formal people manager. This includes supporting day\-to\-day office coordination, onboarding logistics, vendor and facilities management, team integration, and practical office operations.
   

  

 You work in a hybrid environment, spending three days per week in the office and two days remotely, while collaborating closely with colleagues and working daily with modern Microsoft technologies
   

  

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**
**Business Central functional expertise \& modernization**
* Provide functional Business Central expertise, supported by adequate technical understanding, to advise the team and improve ERP support and business processes.
* Define and maintain the Business Central technology roadmap, aligned with Finance priorities and the wider ERP landscape.
* Review how Business Central is currently set up and identify areas that can be simplified, improved or modernized from a technical perspective.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, risk and feasibility.


**Business Central support \& oversight**
* Act as the senior point of contact for Business Central support handled from the India GCC.
* Support L1/L2 Business Central Consultants with guidance on complex tickets.
* Contribute to solving complex Business Central issues.
* Ensure tickets are handled within agreed SLAs.
* Help triage tickets that require coordination between local support, remote support, Business Central and vendors.
* Support prioritization and resolution of finance\-related BC issues, Microsoft 365 issues and workplace support escalations.
* Ensure complex cases are routed to the right specialist, L3 support or external vendor.


**Incident, escalation \& stakeholder management**
* Support handling high\-priority incidents and ensure clear communication, escalation and ownership.
* Coordinate with Copenhagen, Chicago, Singapore, London and vendors during urgent issues.
* Act as the local escalation point for India GCC support matters.
* Track recurring issues, unresolved risks and improvement actions.
* Prepare concise updates for global IT leadership and functional owners.


**Knowledge, governance \& continuous improvement**
* Ensure Business Central SOPs, knowledge articles and handover materials are created, maintained and used consistently.
* Drive improvements across ticket quality, self\-service, automation, documentation and handovers.
* Support onboarding and training of new India GCC IT support team members.
* Help mature follow\-the\-sun working practices and cross\-team collaboration.
* Promote a strong service mindset, structured execution and global ways of working.


**Office management \& local coordination**
* Act as the local office manager and day\-to\-day coordination point for the IT support team in India GCC.
* Serve as the point of contact for coordination with the rest of the India GCC office on behalf of the IT support team.
* Coordinate practical office routines, seating, local onboarding logistics, visitor coordination and local team integration activities.
* Collaborate with Service Desk, facilities, HR and local vendors on office access, equipment, meeting rooms, workplace setup and office\-related issues.
* Escalate local office risks, unresolved issues or service concerns to the relevant global or local owner in a timely manner.


**You**
 We are looking for a motivated individual holding a relevant degree and minimum 10\+ years of experience in Business Central, Dynamics NAV, ERP application support or finance systems support, preferably in a global enterprise environment. You have strong project leadership capabilities and proven track record of optimizing Business Central in complex or global organizations.
   

  

 Strong understanding of finance processes such as invoice processing, posting, expenses, approvals, time registration, FX, master data and dimensions. Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central support, troubleshooting and user guidance. Good understanding of Service Desk ticket handling, including L1/L2 support, prioritization and escalation.
   

  

 Experience working in Jira/Confluence or another ITSM platform, including ticket handling, documentation, prioritization and SLA follow\-up. ITIL, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or relevant finance application certifications are beneficial.
   

  

**We look for the following in a candidate:**
* Excellent English communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a global model, with sufficient overlap with European business hours.
* Able to communicate clearly and professionally with users and stakeholders.
* High responsiveness and ownership in handling support requests.
* Comfortable being office\-based and acting as a visible local coordination point for the India GCC office.
* High attention to detail, strong follow\-up discipline and ability to prioritize during busy periods.
* General IT support knowledge beyond Business Central is a plus.
* Experience with office management, local vendor coordination, onboarding logistics or team coordination is a plus.
* Experience with Allvue or similar fund/investment management platforms is a plus.


**The process**
 Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
   

  

 As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
   

  

 Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
   

  

 \-\-\-

 CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
   

  

 A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.
   

  

**CIP Fund Solutions**
 CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy\-period \- supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large\-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M\&A.

description:
**Role Summary**
 This role is responsible for supporting and administering Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) services on the Okta platform. The position covers operational support, user and access administration, application onboarding, policy management, issue resolution, reporting, and documentation. The role works closely with application owners, TPMs, and support teams to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services for business applications.

* Investigate and resolve access\-related and application\-related issues raised by users and application teams.

**User and Access Administration**
* Manage Okta group mapping for existing applications, including assignment and removal of groups.
* Assign Okta groups to users based on approved access requests.
* Create external user accounts for applications in line with approved business requests.
* Update primary email addresses for external users when required.
* Reset passwords for external users and perform MFA resets as needed.

**Application Onboarding and Configuration**

**Policy and Identity Administration**

* Manage authorization servers, including scopes, claims, and access policies.


**Platform Administration and Continuous Improvement**
* Manage Okta branding elements, including themes, hosted pages, and custom email templates.
* Create and maintain Okta automations and workflows.
* Monitor new Okta feature releases and assess their impact on applications and services.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of CIAM processes and platform capabilities.


**Reporting and Documentation**

* Keep operational and knowledge documents current to support effective service delivery.


**Qualifications**

* Experience in user lifecycle management, access management, and group\-based access control.
* Knowledge of SAML, OIDC, Identity Providers, and authentication mechanisms.
* Experience managing authentication, access, password, MFA, and session policies.
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts and secure access management, with good problem\-solving skills.

* Foundational knowledge of related platforms/tools such as Active Directory (AD), Workday, and CyberArk.

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and incident management skills.
* Good communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with application owners, TPMs, and support teams.


**Key Attributes**
* Strong attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Service\-oriented mindset with a focus on quality and timely resolution.
* Commitment to process compliance, documentation, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Blackboard consultant
description:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are seeking a Senior Blackboard Learn Ultra Consultant to take full technical and functional ownership of a live Blackboard Learn Ultra environment.
 



 The successful candidate will act as the single point of delivery accountability, working closely with IT, academic affairs, registrar teams, faculty, and other stakeholders.
 



  





**The engagement will focus on four key areas:** 




  





**Stabilize → Optimize → Enable → Transfer** 




 The consultant will be responsible for platform stabilization, data and access remediation, identity/SIS integrations, Ultra configuration, course and assessment standardization, faculty enablement, operational support, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Platform Assessment \& Mobilization** 



* Conduct stakeholder interviews and establish project scope and priorities.
* Assess Production, Test/Stage and approved Blackboard environments.
* Inventory configurations, licenses, users, courses, integrations, authentication, reports, support processes, and security/accessibility controls.
* Establish a prioritized remediation backlog with risks, dependencies, owners, timelines, and acceptance criteria.
* Establish appropriate testing, backup, rollback, approval, and change\-management procedures.



**2\. Data, Access \& Integration Remediation** 



* Profile and cleanse Blackboard users, courses, enrollments, terms, roles, organizations, hierarchy nodes, files, archives, and related data.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, orphaned, invalid, stale, or incorrectly configured records.
* Review privileged, manual, guest, service, inactive, and direct\-access accounts.
* Develop and maintain a role\-to\-privilege matrix.
* Review and improve joiner/mover/leaver and access\-review processes.
* Stabilize identity and integration feeds, including reconciliation, monitoring, alerting, recovery, and backfill.
* Develop positive, negative, boundary, and volume test scenarios to prevent unintended data or enrollment changes.



**3\. Blackboard Ultra Administration \& Security** 



* Maintain a complete register of licensed Blackboard capabilities and their readiness, ownership, and adoption status.
* Configure and enable approved Blackboard Ultra capabilities.
* Review Ultra course configuration, Original Course View migration, system roles, SSO/MFA, service accounts, REST/LTI privileges, and integrations.
* Apply least\-privilege and supported\-configuration principles.
* Establish Test/Stage\-to\-Production release and regression\-testing processes.
* Provide recurring platform readiness and operational reporting.
* Support cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility, and WCAG/Ally\-type requirements.



**4\. Course Templates, Assessments \& CLO Mapping** 



* Design and implement institutional Blackboard Ultra course templates and approved variants.
* Standardize course navigation, learning modules, assessment structures, gradebook practices, and accessibility.
* Develop reusable assessment rubrics, question banks/pools, and grading/integrity controls.
* Configure Learning Outcomes/CLO hierarchies.
* Map assignments, tests, and rubric criteria to Course Learning Outcomes.
* Support summative\-assessment mapping across pilot courses.



**5\. Faculty Enablement \& Operational Support** 



* Provide Tier 2/3 onsite support for:
* User access
* Course setup
* Content
* Gradebook
* Assessments
* Integrations
* Data feeds
* Reporting
* Own technical and functional issues through resolution, including vendor escalation when required.
* Deliver faculty workshops, hands\-on course\-building clinics, one\-to\-one consultations, showcases, and office hours.
* Provide targeted support during term starts and major assessment periods.
* Develop faculty/student guides, onboarding checklists, FAQs, and in\-platform guidance.
* Maintain a searchable knowledge base and known\-error log.
* Produce weekly operational and monthly service reports.



**6\. Documentation \& Knowledge Transfer** 



* Maintain complete and editable:
* Architecture documentation
* Configuration documentation
* Data\-flow and field\-mapping documentation
* Data dictionary
* Role matrix
* Test packs
* Change records
* Runbooks
* Support articles
* Course\-template standards
* Training materials
* Conduct structured shadowing and reverse\-shadowing with the client's administrators and support teams.
* Perform a final operational\-readiness review.
* Document residual risks and future improvement opportunities.
* Complete a formal knowledge\-transfer and handover process so the client team can independently operate the platform.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




  





**Blackboard Experience:** 



* **Minimum 12 years of hands\-on Blackboard Learn experience.**
* At least
 **5 years of experience with Blackboard Learn SaaS and Ultra Experience/Ultra Course View** 
 .



 Higher Education Experience
 


* Minimum
 **two comparable higher\-education engagements** 
 .
* At least one engagement must have been delivered within a
 **complex research university** 
 environment.
* Ability to provide verifiable project scope, dates, outcomes, and references.



 SIS \& Integration Experience
 


* Mandatory hands\-on experience integrating Blackboard with
 **Ellucian Banner or a Banner successor** 
 .
* Experience with
 **SAP Student Lifecycle Management (SLcM)** 
 is strongly preferred.



  





**Technical Skills:** 




  





 Strong hands\-on experience with:
 


* Blackboard Learn administration
* Data and user remediation
* SIS integrations
* Identity and authentication feeds
* SSO/MFA
* Roles and security
* REST/LTI integrations
* Release and change management
* Analytics and reporting
* Troubleshooting
* Platform support



**Functional Skills** 




 Strong experience with:
 


* Blackboard Ultra course design
* Course template development
* Gradebook configuration
* Assessment and rubric design
* Blackboard Goals / CLO mapping
* Accessibility remediation
* Faculty training and adoption
* Academic stakeholder engagement



  





**Ideal Candidate:** 




  





 The ideal candidate is a
 **hands\-on Blackboard Learn Ultra specialist** 
 who combines deep technical expertise with strong functional and academic\-facing capabilities.
 



 They should be comfortable working across platform administration, data remediation, SIS/identity integrations, security, course design, assessments, and faculty training.
 



 The candidate should demonstrate strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills and have experience taking ownership of a live, mission\-critical LMS environment within higher education.
 



 The ultimate objective is to leave the client with a
 **stable, optimized, well\-documented, and self\-sufficient Blackboard Ultra operation** 
 .

title: Technical Operations Lead
description:
**Company Overview** 




 Founded in 2012,
 **Occams Advisory** 
 is a leading business solutions, professional services and financial advisory provider specializing in growth, financing, and taxation. Serving as a trusted advisor throughout the business lifecycle, Occams combines Fortune 500 expertise, entrepreneurial insights, and a global perspective to deliver world\-class solutions.
 **Occams has achieved remarkable recognition for its rapid growth, securing 8 spots on Inc. magazine’s Fastest Growing 5000 Private Companies list, 4 consecutive rankings on the Financial Times Fastest Growing 500 Companies in the Americas. In 2023, Occams was honored on Fortune’s inaugural list of the 300 Most Innovative Companies.** 




  





 Operating across all U.S. states and territories, Occams boasts a team of over 100 professionals based in major cities worldwide, including New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, Delhi and Mumbai. Its leadership includes alumni from Fortune 500 companies such as Barclays, UBS, and Merrill Lynch, and prestigious academic institutions like NYU, Duke University, and London Business School. Recognized as a leader in professional services, Occams delivers transformative growth and advisory solutions to clients.
 



  





**About Your Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Lead – Operations** 
 to work directly with the CEO – India as his second in command on the day\-to\-day running of the India teams.
 



 In plain terms, this is the person who stays on top of everything. If Finance says a client agreement is not yet on the portal, you are the one who already has that task in Asana, knows it is stuck because nobody sent the final signed copy, has chased the person who has it, and can tell leadership in one line where it stands. Nothing sits with you and goes quiet, and nobody has to remind you of anything.
 



 You will work across teams: product and technology, finance, client delivery, and our US\-based leadership and partners. Most of your day is getting things moved by people who do not report to you, so you need to be easy to work with and able to build rapport with anyone.
 



 We are looking for someone from an Indian IT services delivery background, where work is finished on the client's deadline and not on the team's convenience. If a deliverable is due on Friday for a US client, it goes out on Friday. You should be comfortable with that way of working and able to build it in the teams around you.
 



 This is also an AI\-native role. Occams is building itself as an AI\-native company: everyone is a builder, work gets recorded so it can be automated, and people write clear specs that AI tools and developers turn into working software. You should already work this way. You use AI tools every day, you can run tasks in Claude Code or a similar tool, and you can write a spec clearly enough that an agent or a developer can build from it. You do not need to be an engineer. You need to be the person who shows the team what AI\-native work looks like.
 



 Our own CRM and ERP platforms are among the main products this role will run, so you need a working knowledge of CRM and ERP software: how it gets built, configured, and rolled out.
 



 You will report to the CEO – India. The role is based in Delhi or Dehradun. Over time, it grows into running operations for the India business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Running operations** 



* **Own the operational tracker.** 
 Every open item across the India teams sits in Asana with an owner, a blocker if there is one, a next step, and a date. You keep it current every day. Nothing that matters lives in an Excel file or a WhatsApp thread.
* **Follow up and close loops.** 
 You chase, you remember why things are stuck, and you get them unstuck. Forwarding a file to someone else does not count as done.
* **Be the single point of status.** 
 Leadership should be able to ask you about any open item and get a clear answer without checking anywhere else.
* **Run meetings that end in actions.** 
 Set the agenda, capture decisions and owners, and put them in Asana the same day.
* **Keep the process paperwork honest.** 
 Write and maintain SOPs for the work you run, and check that they are actually being followed.



**Running projects** 



* **Own scope and requirements.** 
 Turn what leadership and clients ask for into a written scope with acceptance criteria before work starts.
* **Plan and schedule.** 
 Build the plan backwards from the committed date, with milestones, dependencies, and who does what. Spot slippage early and pull in help before the date is at risk, not after.
* **Manage the team's time.** 
 Know who is on what, see overload coming, and move work around before dates slip.
* **Manage risks and issues.** 
 Keep a live risk list, escalate early, and never let a known risk turn into a surprise.
* **Control change.** 
 When scope changes, say what it does to the date and the effort, in writing, before anyone agrees to it.
* **Run quality and acceptance testing.** 
 Define what done means, run acceptance testing with the business users, and sign off before release.
* **Coordinate releases.** 
 Plan go\-lives with the technology team and the business, with communication and a rollback plan ready.
* **Manage vendors.** 
 Own the relationship with outside developers, IT vendors, and SaaS providers: contracts, service levels, and chasing them the way you chase everyone else.
* **Report to stakeholders.** 
 Weekly written status, a monthly review with leadership, and a clear presentation whenever a decision is needed.
* **Track the numbers that matter.** 
 On\-time delivery, age of open items, defects after release. Use them to improve, not just to report.



**Working AI\-native** 



* **Use AI in your own work every day.** 
 Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar, for drafting, analysis, automation, and building small tools.
* **Write specs that AI and developers can build from.** 
 Keep what is wanted separate from how it gets built.
* **Automate the repeated work.** 
 Reporting, status updates, data checks. If a task is done the same way twice, ask whether an agent can do it.
* **Record the work.** 
 Decisions, processes, and outcomes get written down so they can be automated later.
* **Redo workflows when a better way appears.** 
 Be willing to throw out how something is done every few months if AI now does it better.
* **Help the team adopt it.** 
 Show people how, set the example, and call it out when spreadsheets, chat threads, or memory are being used where a system should be.



**Supporting the CEO – India** 



* **Work as his second in command.** 
 Prepare updates, take on tasks delegated to you, and make sure nothing agreed in a leadership conversation gets lost.
* **Present like a consultant.** 
 When a decision is needed, put the problem, the options, and your recommendation in front of leadership or a client, clearly and in a form they can act on.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education:** 



* Bachelor's degree, engineering or similar preferred. PMP, PRINCE2, or a Master's degree is good to have but not required.



**Experience:** 



* 5 to 8 years in project or delivery management at an Indian IT services or software company, with at least 2 years running client deliveries against fixed deadlines.
* At least one stint at a large, well\-organized company, where process, documentation, and delivery discipline were taken seriously. We want you to have seen how it is done properly, and then be able to do it yourself in a 100\-person firm without a large support team behind you.
* Part of a team that built, customized, or rolled out a CRM or ERP product (for example Salesforce, Zoho, Dynamics, SAP, Odoo, or a home\-grown platform). You know what a CRM or ERP implementation actually involves.
* Worked with US\-based clients, or handled a US team, and are comfortable on US calls and US working hours.



  





**Essential technical skills:** 



* **Asana, Jira, or similar as the single source of truth.** 
 You prefer a system over spreadsheets, and you keep it clean.
* **AI tools in daily use.** 
 You can run tasks in Claude Code or a similar tool, and you know what to hand to AI and what to keep for yourself.
* **Presentation skills at the level of an EY or McKinsey consultant.** 
 You can put a problem, the options, and a recommendation in front of leadership or a client, and take the questions.
* **Clear written and spoken English,** 
 comfortable on calls with US stakeholders.
* **A track record of closing things out.** 
 In interviews we will ask for specific examples.
* **Basic understanding of software delivery.** 
 You do not need to code, but you need to understand what the technology team is telling you.



**Preferred Skills:** 



* PMP, PRINCE2, or a Master's degree.
* Hands\-on ERP or CRM operations work, not only project work.
* Built automations with tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n.
* Experience in a professional services or advisory firm.



  





**Benefits \& Perks** 



* **Health Insurance** 
 for you and your dependents including parents
* **Provident Fund**
* **3 % Fixed CTC** 
 Budget for Learning Opportunities
* Market Leading
 **Leave Policy**
* **Paid Holidays** 
 per Calendar Year
* Employee Recognition \& Rewards
* One of the best cultures of
 
 benevolent meritocracy



  





**Job Details** 



* **Title** 
 : Lead \- Operations
* **Annual Compensation:** 
 As per company standards
* **Work Schedule** 
 : Office
* **Nature** 
 : Full time
* **Shift:** 
 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST, aligned to US hours. This is a deadline\-driven role and hours flex when a client commitment needs it.
* **Location:** 
 Delhi, India/ Dehradun, Uttarakhand. Candidates should be based in Delhi, or willing to relocate to Dehradun.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
CPA\-DMV.com is seeking an experienced AI \& Automation Specialist to design, develop, and implement intelligent automation solutions for business and IT support operations.
 



 The primary focus of this role will be to combine Artificial Intelligence, Robotic Process Automation
 



 (RPA), ticketing automation, and AI voice technology to automate Level 1 help desk functions and other repetitive business processes. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience building AI\-powered workflows, integrating systems through APIs, automating support tickets, developing conversational or voice AI agents, and creating reliable escalation processes when human assistance is required. This is a hands\-on implementation role for someone who can convert business requirements into working automation solutions.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI\-Powered Help Desk Automation
 



 ● Design and implement an intelligent help desk and ticket automation system.
 



 ● Automatically receive, categorize, prioritize, and route incoming support requests.
 



 ● Use AI to understand the user's issue and determine the appropriate response or action.
 



 ● Automate common Level 1 support requests and repetitive help desk activities.
 



 ● Create automatic responses for common support questions.
 



 ● Integrate AI with internal knowledge bases and support documentation.
 



 ● Automatically create, update, assign, and close tickets where appropriate.
 



 ● Develop escalation rules for issues requiring Level 2 support or human intervention.
 



 ● Ensure complete ticket history and documentation are maintained.
 



 AI Voice Agent Development
 



 ● Design and configure an AI\-powered voice agent for Level 1 help desk support.
 



 ● Enable the voice agent to answer incoming calls and interact naturally with users.
 



 ● Configure the voice agent to understand common technical and support questions.
 



 ● Provide automated responses and troubleshooting guidance for approved Level 1 issues.
 



 ● Create support tickets automatically based on voice conversations.
 



 ● Capture caller information, issue details, and conversation summaries.
 



 ● Integrate the AI voice agent with ticketing, CRM, communication, and internal systems.
 



 ● Configure intelligent call routing and escalation.
 



 ● Transfer complex, sensitive, or unresolved issues to human support staff.
 



 ● Ensure the human support representative receives the conversation summary and relevant
 



 information during escalation.
 



 Robotic Process Automation
 



 ● Identify repetitive manual processes that can be automated.
 



 ● Design and implement RPA workflows to reduce manual work.
 



 ● Combine RPA with AI to automate decision\-based workflows.
 



 ● Automate data entry, document processing, system updates, notifications, and task creation.
 



 ● Integrate automation across multiple applications and platforms.
 



 ● Monitor automated processes and resolve exceptions or failures.
 



 ● Continuously improve workflows based on performance and user feedback.
 



 AI Agent \& Workflow Development
 



 ● Develop AI agents capable of completing defined business and support tasks.
 



 ● Design prompts, workflows, decision logic, and guardrails.
 



 ● Integrate Large Language Models with business applications.
 



 ● Build knowledge\-base\-driven AI solutions.
 



 ● Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation where appropriate.
 



 ● Configure AI systems to provide accurate responses based on approved company information.
 



 ● Test and monitor AI outputs to reduce incorrect or unsupported responses.
 



 ● Create appropriate confidence thresholds and escalation rules.
 



 System Integration
 



 The specialist will be responsible for integrating AI and automation solutions with systems such as:
 



 ● Help desk and ticketing platforms
 



 ● CRM systems
 



 ● Microsoft 365
 



 ● Email systems
 



 ● Internal databases
 



 ● Cloud storage
 



 ● Document management systems
 



 ● VoIP and telephone systems
 



 ● Accounting and business applications
 



 ● Internal knowledge bases
 



 The candidate should have strong experience working with APIs, webhooks, databases, and third party integrations. Human Escalation \& Exception Handling
 



 A major requirement of this role is ensuring AI automation knows when human involvement is necessary.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 



 ● Define clear escalation rules.
 



 ● Identify issues that cannot be resolved automatically.
 



 ● Escalate complex requests to appropriate human staff.
 



 ● Ensure smooth transfer from AI to human support.
 



 ● Provide the human representative with a summary of the issue and previous interaction.
 



 ● Maintain the ability for employees to review and override automated decisions.
 



 ● Prevent AI from making decisions outside approved areas.
 



 Security \& Confidentiality
 



 Because CPA\-DMV.com handles confidential client and financial information, the candidate must:
 



 ● Follow strict information security and confidentiality standards.
 



 ● Protect customer and company data.
 



 ● Implement appropriate user permissions and role\-based access.
 



 ● Secure APIs, system credentials, and integrations.
 



  





 ● Maintain audit logs for automated activities.
 



 ● Ensure sensitive information is only processed through approved systems.
 



 ● Follow company data retention and privacy requirements.
 



 Documentation \& Training
 



 ● Create documentation for all AI and automation systems.
 



 ● Document workflows, integrations, APIs, escalation processes, and configurations.
 



 ● Develop standard operating procedures.
 



 ● Prepare troubleshooting and support documentation.
 



 ● Train employees on newly implemented AI and automation solutions.
 



 ● Maintain an internal knowledge base for support processes.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 ● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science,
 



 Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience with Artificial Intelligence and automation technologies.
 



 ● Experience implementing Robotic Process Automation.
 



 ● Experience working with Large Language Models and generative AI.
 



 ● Experience with AI agents or conversational AI solutions.
 



 ● Experience integrating applications using APIs and webhooks.
 



 ● Understanding of databases and system integrations.
 



 ● Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Ability to understand business processes and convert them into automated workflows.
 



 ● Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 Preferred Technical Skills
 



 Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:
 



 ● OpenAI API / Azure OpenAI
 



 ● Microsoft Azure AI
 



 ● Python
 



 ● JavaScript / TypeScript
 



 ● Microsoft Power Automate
 



 ● UiPath
 



 ● Automation Anywhere
 



 ● n8n
 



 ● Make
 



 ● Zapier
 



 ● Microsoft Power Platform
 



 ● Twilio
 



 ● Voice AI platforms
 



 ● Speech\-to\-Text technologies
 



 ● Text\-to\-Speech technologies
 



 ● REST APIs
 



 ● Webhooks
 



 ● SQL
 



 ● CRM integrations
 



 ● Help desk systems
 



 ● Vector databases
 



 ● RAG / Knowledge Base solutions
 



 ● Microsoft 365 integrations
 



 ● AWS / Azure / Google Cloud
 



 The candidate is not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. Initial Projects
 



 The selected candidate will initially focus on three major projects:
 



 1\. AI Help Desk Ticket Automation
 



 Create an AI\-powered help desk solution that can:
 



 ● Receive support requests
 



 ● Understand user issues
 



 ● Categorize tickets
 



 ● Determine priority
 



 ● Provide automated Level 1 responses
 



 ● Assign tickets to the appropriate department
 



 ● Escalate unresolved issues
 



 ● Maintain ticket history and documentation
 



 2\. AI Voice Agent for Level 1 Support
 



 Develop a voice\-based AI agent capable of:
 



 ● Answering incoming support calls
 



 ● Identifying the caller's issue
 



 ● Providing approved troubleshooting assistance
 



 ● Answering common questions
 



 ● Creating support tickets
 



 ● Summarizing conversations
 



 ● Escalating complex requests
 



 ● Transferring users to human support when necessary
 



 3\. RPA \+ AI Business Process Automation
 



 Identify repetitive internal processes and implement automation solutions combining RPA and AI to improve speed, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
 



 Ideal Candidate
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on AI automation professional who can understand a business problem
 



 and independently design, build, integrate, test, and maintain a working solution.
 



 We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously developed:
 



 ● AI help desk systems
 



 ● Ticket automation
 



 ● AI voice agents
 



 ● RPA workflows
 



 ● AI\-powered business automation
 



 ● CRM or customer support integrations
 



 ● AI agents connected to company knowledge bases
 



 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Success in this position will include:
 



 ● Reduced manual Level 1 help desk workload
 



 ● Faster response times
 



 ● Improved ticket routing and prioritization
 



 ● Successful automation of repetitive processes
 



 ● Reliable AI\-to\-human escalation
 



 ● Accurate call and ticket documentation
 



 ● Secure handling of confidential information
 



 ● Measurable improvements in operational efficience

title: Cross Technology Service Delivery Field Support Engineer (L1)
description:

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Cross Technology Service Delivery Field Support Engineer (L1\) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a professional first\-line remote and/or onsite technical support and field engineering service to clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
   

  

 Through pre\-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role restores service to clients by managing incidents and seeing them through to an effective resolution.
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to ensure all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed Service Level Agreement (SLA) conditions.
   

  

 The Cross Technology Service Delivery Field Support Engineer (L1\) is responsible for managing standard and low complexity incidents, conducting routine, repetitive tasks whilst using readily available information and following standard practices and procedures.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Ensures that the assigned infrastructure at the client site is configured, installed, tested and operational.
* Ensures that any software that is part of the solution is installed and configured according to client requirements.
* Proactively identifies problems and errors as they occur and logs such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail.
* Liaises with all stakeholders including client IT environments, carriers and colleagues to expediate diagnosis of errors and problems and to identify a resolution.
* Investigates first line support calls assigned and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems following knowledge articles.
* Responds to and diagnoses all alerts, escalate to L2 Field Engineer when unable to resolve within the stipulated time.
* Ensures incidents are updated with progress and resolution details in a timely manner using the required platform.
* Ensures the efficient and comprehensive resolution of incidents and requests.
* Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log, report on and correct configuration items, components and changes.
* Investigates problems in systems, processes and services and assists with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
* Provide sfirst line remote and onsite technical support to clients.
* Provides first line field engineering services to clients.
* Reports and escalates issues to 3rd party vendors if necessary.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Good communicate skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and take into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.

 in our Customer experience team.
   

  

 Kapture CX is an AI\-native, verticalized SaaS platform helping enterprises automate and execute complex customer and business workflows.
   

  

 At the core of Kapture is AgentOS — our Agentic Operating System that brings together AI agents, human intelligence, enterprise systems, and operational intelligence to execute work end\-to\-end. AgentOS enables enterprises to build, deploy, orchestrate, monitor, evaluate, and optimize AI\-powered workflows across customer support, sales, collections, claims, and other business operations.

 As a

**,**
